title: The vet, 2026
logline: The vet's step, the pup at eleven, the leash on the rail, and this time a hand on the rail too, from the page's edge, staying. The page goes no further than the step; what's inside is reserved.

panels.composition: A veterinary clinic's front step with an old three-legged dog sitting on it, its leash on the rail, a man's hand on the rail from the page's edge, the door shut.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a veterinary clinic's front step with an old three-legged dog sitting on it and its leash looped on the rail, a man's hand resting on the rail from the page's edge, the door shut, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
